title: fix(app-shell): Assigned Users confirms Remove and offers organization members only (objectui#13408)
body:
Closes #13408
Clause-②: no

Claim: the `domain:ui` seat 1 claim on the card (branch `claude/issue-13408-assigned-users-confirm`).

## What changes

Setup → Permission Sets → a set's page, Assigned Users. This copies the `PositionHoldersSection` shape from #13398 (objectui#13337).

1. **Remove asks first.** Remove on a direct grant opens an in-app `AlertDialog` that names the person (`Remove Dana Direct from this permission set?`). Nothing is sent until the confirm. Cancel writes nothing. Confirm deletes the grant row by its id, as before, and a refused delete is still said in the server's words. The row button keeps its `Remove` name. Rows held through a position still show no Remove.
2. **The add picker offers organization members only.** On Add user, the section reads the active organization's `sys_member` rows (paged, 500 a page, until a short page). It hands their `user_id`s to `RecordPickerDialog` as `baseFilter: { id: { $in: [...] } }`. A refused read is said in the server's words and the picker stays shut. An organization with no member rows says so. With no active organization, or no `sys_member` object registered, the picker keeps its whole list.
3. **One membership read for both pages.** The paged `sys_member` read and the "is membership judged here" test move out of `PositionHoldersSection` into a new `organization-members.ts` beside it (`membershipOrganization`, `readOrganizationMemberIds`). Both sections use it. `PositionHoldersSection` behaves as before. Its #13337 pins are unchanged and still green, because they mock only `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/fields`, none of which moved.

Copy: each section keeps its own inline `useCopy` (en / zh-CN). I reused #13398's `noMembers`, `membersFailed` and `cancel` strings word for word. `removeTitle` and `removeBody` say "permission set" where #13398 says "position". No `packages/i18n` locale file is touched, so no parity keys were added.

## Measured first: the server already refuses this grant

objectstack's `grant-holder-membership-refusal` (plugin-security) is registered on both `sys_user_position` and `sys_user_permission_set`, so a permission set grant is not a gap. A non-system insert of a `sys_user_permission_set` row is refused with `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` and `reference_not_found` at `user_id` when its `user_id` holds no `sys_member` row in the row's stored organization. That organization is the row's own, or the caller's active organization, which the driver stamps in. Its module note says `sys_user_permission_set` "is the same class" and "the same predicate applies to it". Its test suite covers it in `sys_user_permission_set: an organization-scoped grant takes the same predicate`.

The rule is present at this repo's `.objectstack-sha` pin and on objectstack `origin/main`. It stands down where this picker keeps its whole list: a row stored with no organization (a global grant), or a composition with no `sys_member`. So no server half is needed, and none was filed. This picker now offers only people the server will accept.

## Tests

- `AssignedUsersSection.confirmAndMembers-13408.test.tsx` (new), with the same cases as the #13337 pin:
  - Remove opens a confirm naming the grantee and sends nothing. Cancel writes nothing and the row stays. Confirm deletes `sys_user_permission_set` `grant_1`, once.
  - Add reads `sys_member` `{ $filter: { organization_id: 'org_1' }, $top: 500, $skip: 0 }` and the picker gets `{ id: { $in: ['u_1', 'u_3'] } }`. The other organization's `u_9` is left out.
  - Every page of the membership is read.
  - A refused read shows the server's sentence and the picker stays shut.
  - An empty organization says so and opens no picker.
  - With no active organization, or no `sys_member` registered, the picker opens unfiltered and reads no membership.
- `AssignedUsersSection.test.tsx` (`REMOVE deletes the direct grant by its row id`) and `AssignedUsersSection.readRefused-12706.test.tsx` (`a refused Remove says so in the server's words, and the row stays`): each now clicks through the new confirm (`assigned-user-remove-confirm`) before its existing assertions. Nothing else in them changed.
- Ablation, run on the committed head and then restored, with `git diff HEAD` empty after each leg:
  - Remove wired straight to `removeUser` again: the two confirm tests fail.
  - `baseFilter={memberFilter}` dropped: the two filter tests fail. The refused-read, empty, and fallback tests stay green, as expected, since they do not read the filter.
  - The shared helper limited to one page: `reads every page of the membership` fails in both the #13408 and the #13337 pins, which shows both sections run through the lifted read.

Local runs on `91d8605897`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over every test file that names `AssignedUsersSection`, `PositionHoldersSection` or `organization-members` (32 files, including the PermissionMatrixEditor suites, `setupHoldersGrant-12082` and plugin-form's `affordanceGrantMap-12082` write-site ledger, whose `removeUser` and `addUsers` keys are unchanged): exit 0, 32 files, 244 tests passed.
- `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm exec turbo run type-check --concurrency=2 --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0, 30 of 30 tasks. The package's `type-check` also runs `tsconfig.test.json`.
- `pnpm exec eslint` over the six changed source and test files: exit 0, no errors. The warnings are the files' existing `any` style. The new helper adds none.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: passes, with one patch changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`.

## Acceptance notes

- Docs: `content/docs/guide/console.md` has a Setup Positions row (updated by #13398) but no Setup Permission Sets row, so there is nothing to update in place. Adding a row is outside this card's declared file surface. The app-shell README item on the Setup holders sections describes their grant gates only, and #13398 left it as is too.

## File surface

As declared: `AssignedUsersSection.tsx`, `PositionHoldersSection.tsx` (the lift only), the new `organization-members.ts`, tests beside them, and one `.changeset/` patch.

## Checklist

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
